evidence.basis: Project-wide MD and Lua event-contract analysis for X4 RegisterEvent bindings.

guidance.title: MD event has no Lua registration
guidance.why: The project-wide contract scan found an MD-raised event that no project Lua source registers.
guidance.impact: The intended MD-to-Lua handoff cannot reach a handler.
guidance.next: Register the exact event in Lua or correct the MD event name so both sides match.

evidence.basis: Project-wide Lua and MD event-contract analysis for X4 UI event listeners.

guidance.title: Lua UI event has no MD listener
guidance.why: The project-wide contract scan found a Lua-emitted UI event that no project MD cue listens for.
guidance.impact: The intended Lua-to-MD handoff cannot trigger its cue.
guidance.next: Add the matching MD listener or correct the Lua event name so both sides match.

evidence.basis: Configured X4 XSD selected by deterministic schema routing.

guidance.title: Game schema rejected this structure
guidance.why: The XML element, attribute, value, or placement does not satisfy the routed X4 game schema.
guidance.impact: X4 may reject the document or ignore the affected structure.
guidance.next: Align the named element or attribute with the schema diagnostic.
